tools.name: calculate_dscr
tools.description: Debt service coverage ratio for a DSCR (investor) mortgage: qualifying rent / PITIA. Computes exact principal and interest with the annuity formula (monthly compounding, half-up cents) or the interest-only payment, adds tax, insurance, HOA and other housing costs per the Fannie Mae PITIA definition,

tools.name: max_loan_for_target_dscr
tools.description: Solves for the largest whole-dollar loan whose PITIA keeps the DSCR at or above a target (default 1.25), given rent, rate, term, interest-only choice, tax, insurance and HOA. Optional purchase_price and max_ltv_pct give the minimum down payment and which limit binds. Exact cents arithmetic, checked

tools.name: rent_needed_for_target_dscr
tools.description: Solves for the smallest monthly rent (to the cent, and rounded up to whole dollars) that reaches a target DSCR (default 1.25) for a given loan, rate, term, tax, insurance, HOA and vacancy. Also returns the rent for 0.75, 1.00 and 1.25. Rounds up, never down, so the rent always meets the target.

tools.name: compare_scenarios
tools.description: Compares 1 to 5 financing scenarios (rate, down payment, term, interest-only) on one property: loan amount, P&I, PITIA, DSCR, lender band, rent minus PITIA and total interest over the term. Names the scenario with the highest DSCR.

tools.name: amortization_summary
tools.description: Exact month-by-month amortization: monthly payment, number of payments, final payment, total interest, total paid and the remaining balance after chosen years. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "rent_needed_for_target_dscr" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
